docs.title: Welcome to the Mindustry Mod Wiki!
docs.text:
mods show up on this wiki if they are on the mod browser, have at least 10 stars, and can run on build 158

some mods might not show up due to errors during the loading process

also only around 250 mods can actually be shown here due to github REST API rate limit

docs.title: Exoprosopa
docs.text:
Property Value Repository https://github.com/tnmspiroct/exoprosopa Stars 58 Last updated 2026-06-27T03:55:57Z

Exoprosopa adds Frostnova as a third planet into the game alongside with its own unique techtree and environment.

Polished content & linear campaign progression.

Capture and conquer with over 22 campaign maps.

Over 21 items to be discovered, 265 blocks to be researched. and 30 different units to build!

Harvest the planet with your technology before Astral Infection awaken and conquer the entire planet.

Thankyou for playing this mod!

You can contributes maps or gives suggestions by join Exoprosopa Discord Server!

Check it on my profile. My username is TnmSpiroct.

docs.title: Aluminium Furnace
docs.text: Heats cobalt into aluminium using anthracite as a fuel.

docs.title: Aluminium Refinery Forge
docs.text: Heats nickel and cobalt using anthracite in a large amount, this process allows for bulk aluminium production.

docs.title: Cryogenics Purifier
docs.text: Purifies elixir using tantrium as a filter.

docs.title: Cryogenics Autofreezer
docs.text: Purifies elixir faster than elixir purifier. Additionally utilizes cobalt for better efficiency.

docs.title: Cryogenics Synthesis Chamber
docs.text: Purifies elixir into cryogenics without dematerializing it. Uses nucridscrap as a main fuel, requires medium amount of power.

docs.title: Terraformic Basin
docs.text: Uses cryogenics to transform nickel, exposing high charge clevorite. Outputs cobalt and elixir as a byproduct.

docs.title: Terrafilter
docs.text: Uses cryogenics and miasma to transform nickel into clevorite, has a high conversion rate and does not produce any side-products.

docs.title: Nichrome Disassembler
docs.text: Crafts clevorite with nichrome and cryogenics. Produces aluminium and chromium as a byproduct.

docs.title: Ichor Infuser
docs.text: Infuse cryogenics with tantrium to produce ichor.

docs.title: Heavy Ichor Infuser
docs.text: Infuse cryogenics with nucridscrap to produce large amount of ichor. Requires heat to operate.

docs.title: Laminator
docs.text: Produces lamine by fusing anthracite and nickel with miasma acting as a mediator.

docs.title: Blast Chamber
docs.text: Converts clevorite into large amounts of lamine with the aid of ichor.

docs.title: Tantraformer
docs.text: Grinds nickel and anthracite to create tantrium. Due to a flaw in the design process, the elixir must first be taken out before being put back in.

docs.title: Aquamarine Filter
docs.text: Uses hydryite to filter aquamarine into cobalt and nichrome.

docs.title: Elemental Separator
docs.text: Separates nichrome using tantrium and hydryite.

docs.title: Morphite Accelerator
docs.text: Accelerates chromium to great speeds using cryogenics to create morphite. Produces ectoplasm as a byproduct.

docs.title: Morphite Discharger
docs.text: Heats morphite with miasma and ichor to create morphitix plasma.

docs.title: Anthracite Heater
docs.text: Burns anthracite to produce small amounts of heats.

docs.title: Miasma Heater
docs.text: Uses organic fuel to produce moderate amounts of heats.

docs.title: Radiative Heater
docs.text: Uses lamine and nucliogen to produce large amounts of heats.

docs.title: Sunlit Heater
docs.text: Uses necroplasm to produce extensive amount of heats.

docs.title: Heat Connector
docs.text: Transfers heat to another block.

docs.title: Heat Splitter
docs.text: Splits heat into 3 different outputs.

docs.title: Biocrafter
docs.text: Breaks down nucliogen into basic bio-elixir. Works better on nucridscrap surface.

docs.title: Enchanting Basin
docs.text: Enchants and combines nucridscrap with petal fragment to create bloodstone, requires nucliogen and power.

docs.title: Gravitix Chamber Core
docs.text: Utilizes an extremely strong magnetic field to fuse multiple materials into gravitix, requires ichor and large amount of heats to operate.

docs.title: Necrolysis Boiler
docs.text: Turns miasma into necroplasm in extreme heats.

docs.title: Technoworks
docs.text: Further refines technoscrap into techplate by heating and cooling it repeatedly.

docs.title: Pyroforge
docs.text: Creates pyroxene from the strongest material, requires a large amount of necroplasm to convert.

docs.title: Biotic Incinerator
docs.text: Uses miasma to burn inputted items.

docs.title: Toxocida
docs.text: Convert hydryite into necroplasm. Requires power. Astral exclusive block.

docs.text: Moves items forward. Only capable of storing a single item.

docs.text: Generates large amount of power via morphitix plasma and ichor. Explodes violently if has no sufficient fluids.

docs.title: Influx

docs.text: Mainly used in units and electronic parts.

docs.title: Nichrome
docs.text: Fused nickel and chromium, known as nichrome. Can be separated using elemental separators.

docs.title: Chromium
docs.text: Tough and strong material used in many buildings and ammunition.

docs.title: Clevorite
docs.text: Super conductive material that is used in many advanced buildings.

docs.title: Nucridscrap
docs.text: Strong material originating from nucrid walls, can be strengthend more with petal fragments.

docs.title: Petal Fragment
docs.text: Extracted flower petal, can be processed with nucridscrap to produce bloodstone.

docs.title: Bloodstone
docs.text: High durability material used in advanced unit assembly and gravity manipulation.

docs.title: Morphite
docs.text: Crystallic, high energy material from highly accelerated low-tier material. Used in electric-based component blocks and weaponry.

docs.title: Gravitix
docs.text: Strong material used in gravity manipulation based technology and advanced component parts.

docs.title: Pyroxenes
docs.text: High-tech material used in self-healing components.

docs.title: Technoscrap
docs.text: Bunch of metal scraps, needs filtering before it is usable.

docs.title: Techno Plating
docs.text: Stores decent amount of information and data, used in logic-related blocks.

docs.title: Gryphic
docs.text: Refined cobalt, more durable thanks to the added necroplasm.

docs.title: Crystallic Geode
docs.text: Crystalline morphite, it is unknown how they form.

docs.title: Morphitix Crystal
docs.text: Another morphite form, uses accelerated crystal instead of normal material.

docs.title: Elixir
docs.text: Contaminated water mixed with biomass, can be filtered for coolant or used in factories.

docs.title: Cryogenics
docs.text: Filtered elixir, able to operate advanced factories. Can be used as turret coolant.

docs.title: Ichor
docs.text: Truly purified fluids, self-healing technology and stable regeneration.

docs.title: Necroplasm
docs.text: Biological mutated liquids, grows slowly until it gained its intelligence mutation.

docs.title: Miasma
docs.text: Uncontrollable mass of sulfuric acid, can spread into elixir.

docs.title: Hydryite
docs.text: Used in cleaning aquamarine, an elixir counterpart.

docs.title: Morphitix Plasma
docs.text: Plasma created by heating and discharging morphite.

docs.title: Ectoplasm
docs.text: A deadly liquid created from miasma, highly explosive. Can spread into elixir.

docs.title: Nucliogen
docs.text: Slimy substance, byproduct from surrounding petal flower.

docs.title: Frostnova
docs.text: The rampant, filled with dangerous natives.

docs.title: Newgrounds
docs.text:
The Mothership sent you to this sector as your first mission.

Analyze available resources and build infrastructure to protect yourself.

docs.title: Mountain Ridge
docs.text:
The only path available from sector Newgrounds.

This sector is rich in tantrium and anthracite. Research the Elixir Purifier and the Burner Generator to weather the enemies.

docs.title: Encampment
docs.text:
This sector is scarce in cobalt and anthracite deposits in the walls. Bore Jets are required to mine ores from the ground.

The enemy has built a small outpost here with lots of defence. Mech and Walker units will be required to increase your offensive ability.

docs.title: Cliffside
docs.text:
This sector contains deposits of chromium. Use Bore Jet to mine it from the ground.

The enemy will send one of their elites to protect this sector.

docs.title: Crest
docs.text:
This sector is very rough and cramped. Mech units are the only choice to take down the enemy base here.

Push them back in the limited space provided. Claim this sector for yourself.

docs.title: Botanical Garden
docs.text:
This sector contains large deposits of chromium on the opposite side of the island. Perfect to test out new transport tech.

Research Surge Driver and Shipbay Upgrade Chamber to capture the enemy outpost nearby.

docs.title: Escarpment
docs.text:
An important transportation route between outposts used by Rhodes. To make up for the lack of tantrium in the area, research the Tantraformer to create tantrium as the replacement.

Rhodes does not take kindly to you being here and will do their utmost to stop you.

docs.title: Cornerstone
docs.text:
You land on a sector filled with mountainous terrain. The enemy base is hidden deep within. Tier two units may prove necessary to take down their fortifications.

Research the Tankbay Upgrade Chamber and the Walker Upgrade Chamber.

docs.title: Hazardous Wasteland
docs.text:
Rich in miasma but starved of anthracite, this sector is very treacherous. Build Geothermal Generator to generate power.

The enemy has built a strong base with advanced tech in this sector. Capture this sector and acquire the technology.

docs.title: Precipice
docs.text:
A jagged, fractured canyon formerly used as Mech Testing Grounds by Rhodes. The unsupported terrain makes it very hard to build and operate a base.

Utilize Surge Launcher for transporting resources across the winding terrain. Be prepared for attacks from multiple directions.

docs.title: Creek
docs.text:
A ravine carved by flowing hydryite and rich aquamarine deposits. Research the Aquamarine Filter and the Elemental Separator as an alternative ways to produce basic materials.

Our radar detected several Rhodes activity in this sector. Do not give them time to send their strongest units.

docs.title: Marshlands
docs.text:
This sector is very large and rich in resources, but will be attacked by the enemy once a new core lands.

Utilizes morphite for further colonization. Rhodes will send a large punitive force in order to stop your conquest.

docs.title: Pier
docs.text:
This sector was used by Gowa Industries long ago, it has been claimed by Rhodes over the course of countless wars. The pier and its facility became abandoned and decayed.

Astral naval units have been sighted on the radar, no further data available. It might be stronger than normal units.

Unidentified aircraft detected.

Utilize morphitix plasma to create even stronger defences. Use your best strategy against them.

docs.title: Bioproject Core
docs.text:
An abandoned research facility, toxic and unhabitable. Vent is scarce and separated across several islands, analyze the remaining tech to survive.

Utilize Miasma Filtration Unit as an alternative solution. Additionally, research Cargo Bay as a main drone-based transportation.

Landing area is unstable, disallowed additional starting blocks.

docs.title: Eridanus
docs.text:
A zigzag pattern, forces enemy units to take a very long path take out your base in this sector. Dont be fooled by its large wave spacing, Rhodes will send their units faster the more you progress.

Produce gravitix. Fend off the enemy.

WIP

docs.title: Luminary
docs.text:
Due to lack of vents, you will need a better source of power. It might be a good idea to have air defence around the edges.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Foggy Fields
docs.text:
Due to a great number of vents present, the sector has occasional foggy episodes. The enemy has built a giant base here. It is recommended to bring large amounts firepower.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Abandoned Reservoir
docs.text:
You land in a cramped sector filled with miasma. The sensor detects an enemy base in this sector.

Unfortunately, you must build your production and defence between a lake and distorted environment. Use ship units to dismantle the enemy base before the enemy dismantles you.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Trekker Campsite
docs.text:
This is the campsite of the mountain trekker, controlled by Rhodes. Use various units to eliminate all enemy cores.

Intel suggests the enemy has nuclear weapons of some form, stay alert for a potential strike!

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Ridgeline
docs.text:
Rhodes have built a heavily guarded stronghold here. It remains undefeated for years. Your goal is to find any exploit and all weaknesses in order to make it fall.

Modifiers: - Terraformic Basin, Terrafilter & Nichrome Dissembler are unavailable.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Clover Springs
docs.text:
Hotspring occupied by the Rhodes Facility. The lakes generates at the central area, creating almost perfect four clover leafes with several twists.

You will land on a pre-built base from another agent. Advance to the crater and eliminate all enemy cores.

WIP

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Myrra Heights
docs.text:
The highest mountain range in frostnova. A home to the Rhodes mightiest operation known. The enemy have been constructing an experimental gravitix warhead.

BEWARE OF POTENTIAL STRIKE.

We will attempt to sent units to aid your endevors of conquest, by contacting Signal Transmission Station. The enemy values this sector with all of their might. So expect large amounts of resistance and strife in a myriad of ways.

WIP

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Ending
docs.text: Are we reaching The.. End.. ??

docs.title: Breached
docs.text: Whenever a unit gets breached, its health gets slowly drained.

docs.title: Immunity
docs.text: Increases unit health and movement speed, but decreases the damage output.

docs.title: Discharge Overload
docs.text: Whenever a unit gets discharge overload, its health drains very fast.

docs.title: Boosted
docs.text: Increases movement speed and firerate.

docs.title: Overboosted
docs.text: Increases movement speed and firerate significantly.

docs.title: Contaminated
docs.text: Whenever a unit gets contaminated, its health gets slowly drained and gains increased attack speed.

docs.title: Ground Shock
docs.text: Shocks enemies and drains unit health slowly.

docs.title: Stunned
docs.text: Disarm and stuns units in place.

docs.title: Doom
docs.text: Slows units and slowly damaging them.

docs.title: Rogue
docs.text: Protects the Apex Core, can build and retrieve resources. Can heal allied structures.

docs.title: Pioneer
docs.text: Protects the Empower Core, can build and retrieve resources. Can heal blocks.

docs.title: Trailblaze
docs.text: Protects the Apeirogon Core, can build and retrieve resources. Can heal blocks very fast.

docs.title: Suzuran
docs.text: Used for insta-healing blocks and scouting, sandbox only.

docs.title: Huntress
docs.text: Fifth generation of helicopter tech. Equipped with mounted missile and machinegun.

docs.title: Strike
docs.text: Fires pairs of plasma bolts at enemy targets.

docs.title: Skyblade
docs.text: Charges and fires high damage piercing plasma orb over long distances. Has dual laser canons attached on the sides and a shield in the front.

docs.title: Archangel
docs.text: Fires a long-range piercing round. Equipped with dual suppression missiles launcher.

docs.title: Beth
docs.text: Protects the Astral core, can mine and build. Astral exclusive units.

docs.title: Coronis
docs.text: Protects the Crest Core, can build and retrieve resources faster. Can attack enemy units.

docs.title: Sepia
docs.text: Protects the Boundless Core, can build and retrieve resources faster. Can attack enemy units.

docs.title: Locust
docs.text: Protects the Ultimatum Core, can build and retrieve resources faster. Equipped with additional mount weapon.

docs.title: Honsha
docs.text: Third generation of tank tech. Equipped with mounted missile and piercing gun.

docs.title: Craig
docs.text: Launches artillery shells at enemy ground targets.

docs.title: Bastion
docs.text: Fires piercing bullets at enemy targets.

docs.title: Bulwark
docs.text: Fires cluster bombs over large distances.

docs.title: Fortis
docs.text: Fires cluster shells that creating caustic lava puddles upon impact at enemy ground targets.

docs.title: Rancor
docs.text: Fires powerful cluster shells and piercing bullet at enemy targets.

docs.title: Baron
docs.text: Torches enemy targets with a short range laser. Can walk over most terrain.

docs.title: Tribune
docs.text: Fires missiles from a twin missile launcher. Can walk over most terrain.

docs.title: Archon
docs.text: Fires barrages of missiles at enemy targets. Can walk over most terrain.

docs.title: Emperor
docs.text: Fires a piercing bolt at enemy targets. Will dash every second shot. Can walk over most terrain.

docs.title: Monarch
docs.text: Fires piercing shrapnel at multiple enemies in range. Has mounted seeking missiles suited for medium range and lower. Can walk over most terrain.

docs.title: Spark
docs.text: Fires electric arcs at enemies, able to float over bodies of liquid.

docs.title: Sora
docs.text: Fires short electric beams at enemies, able to float over bodies of liquid.

docs.title: Byte
docs.text: Fires electric bullets at enemies. Protects itself with a directional shield.

docs.title: Syntax
docs.text: Fires electric orbs that inflict a stunned effect at enemies. Protects itself with a directional shield.

docs.title: Decode
docs.text: Fires piercing laser that inflict a stunned effect at enemies. Protects itself with a directional shield.

docs.title: Matrix
docs.text: Fires pulsing bullets that inflict a stunned effect at enemies. Creates strong energy shields to nearby units. Damages nearby units when destroyed.

docs.title: Program
docs.text: Fires impaling bullets that explodes upon contact. Equipped with point-defense turret. Capable to self regenerate. Damages nearby units when destroyed.

docs.title: Blastum
docs.text: Explode violently damaging enemies in area.

docs.title: Scorcher
docs.text: Fires flames at enemies.

docs.title: Bulbhead
docs.text: Fires exploding bullet at enemies. Astral exclusive unit.

docs.title: Hammerhead
docs.text: Fires missile at enemies. Astral exclusive unit.

docs.title: Narhwal
docs.text: Fires electric bullets at enemies. Astral exclusive unit.

docs.title: Freesia
docs.text: Fires multiple exploding bullet at enemies, can also heal allied units. Astral exclusive unit.
